from Bio import Entrez
import json

Entrez.email = "test@example.com"

# Search NCBI Gene for MPP3 and NEGR1 in Homo sapiens
def get_ncbi_gene_info(symbol):
    handle = Entrez.esearch(db="gene", term=f"{symbol}[Gene Name] AND Homo sapiens[Organism]")
    record = Entrez.read(handle)
    handle.close()
    gene_ids = record["IdList"]
    if not gene_ids:
        return None
    gene_id = gene_ids[0]
    
    handle = Entrez.esummary(db="gene", id=gene_id)
    summary = Entrez.read(handle)
    handle.close()
    return summary
